card.name: Scattered function-like spots in lists and prose
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on small connecting spots like 'the', 'his', commas in drug lists, 'or', and spaces before numbered steps.

modes.label: Commas and 'or' in drug lists
modes.description: Separators between listed drug names in interaction statements.

modes.label: Small words in religious prose
modes.description: Words like 'the' or 'his' inside quoted scripture or Torah commentary.
modes.example: By Rabbi Daniel Travis "The servant [Eliezer] took ten camels from<< his>> master’s camels…" The Torah

card.plain: It has no clear theme; it fires on small connecting spots, and mainly keeps words like severe or chronic from coming next.
